ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels; high-intensity values are restricted to <5% of the total visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity pigmentation across the main fluke surface; distinct high-contrast white geometric clusters localized exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression at the central divide; approximate aperture angle of 135 degrees with a smooth vertex curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) occurring along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased jaggedness on the inner right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge, originating at the median notch and sweeping upward to the distal apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups located at the extreme left and right distal tips, indicating barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive localized barnacle colonization at the distal tips of both fluke lobes, creating distinct textural and intensity deviations from the primary surface.
